...because I like coming up with card ideas

Master. Archetype.

Put this card on a vampire you control, and choose a ready unique minion controlled by another Methuselah. If an successful bleed action taken by the chosen minion would cause his or her Methuselah to gain the Edge, you gain the Edge instead. A vampire can have only one Archetype.
